title: Sorn: Southern Thai Fine Dining (Bangkok)
description: Secure a seat at one of Asia's most exclusive restaurants. Sorn holds two Michelin stars and elevates blisteringly spicy Southern Thai cuisine to an art form.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> * Sorn, a two-Michelin-starred restaurant in a 90-year-old Sukhumvit house, offers a 20+ course Southern Thai tasting menu, focusing on hyper-local ingredients from 14 Southern Thai provinces and traditional charcoal cooking.
> * The 3-hour dining experience features dishes like raw Phuket lobster and a 12-hour charcoal-cooked 'stink bean' curry, representing a challenging yet rewarding fine-dining option in Bangkok.
> * Asia Golf Specialists (AGS) provides priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury SUV transfers for Sorn, which is open year-round and requires advance booking.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Secure a seat at one of Asia's most exclusive restaurants. Sorn holds two [Michelin](https://guide.michelin.com/us/en) stars and elevates blisteringly spicy Southern Thai cuisine to an art form.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Sorn focuses obsessively on lost recipes and hyper-local ingredients sourced exclusively from the 14 provinces of Southern [Thailand](/destinations/thailand/). Their technique relies on traditional charcoal cooking and complex fermentation, completely avoiding modern gas stoves.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
You arrive at the beautifully reconstructed 90-year-old house in Sukhumvit. The 20+ course tasting menu is an intense, unyielding exploration of spice and temperature. 

You'll experience dishes like raw Phuket lobster and a 'stink bean' curry that has been slow-cooked over charcoal for 12 hours. It is arguably the most challenging and rewarding fine-dining experience in the capital.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Fiery, Exclusive, Uncompromising |
| **Duration** | 3 Hours |
| **Physical Demand** | None |
| **Best Paired With** | A celebratory final night in Bangkok. |

## Securing Bangkok’s Hardest Table After 18 Holes at Thai Country Club or Ballyshear
Tucked inside a restored two-story tropical garden villa on Sukhumvit Soi 26—just 15 minutes from [Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok](/accommodations/thailand/sindhorn-kempinski/)—Chef Supaksorn "Ice" Jongsiri’s **Sorn** is widely regarded as the most coveted dining reservation in Thailand. Holding three Michelin stars in the latest Thailand Michelin Guide, Sorn releases its monthly seats to the public in seconds; for discerning golf groups traveling on [Thailand Ultimate Golf](/tours/thailand-royal-siam/) or [Bangkok & Hua Hin](/tours/the-bangkok-and-hua-hin-fairways/), Asia Golf Specialists coordinates priority table requests 60 to 90 days ahead of your arrival.

Because the 22-bite progression spans three hours of theatrical tableside service, we schedule Sorn following an early 07:30 AM championship round at [Thai Country Club](/courses/thailand/thai-country-club/), [Ballyshear Golf Links](/courses/thailand/ballyshear/), or [Alpine Golf Club](/courses/thailand/alpine-golf-club/), giving your fourball all afternoon to rest poolside at [Sindhorn Kempinski](/accommodations/thailand/sindhorn-kempinski/) before your 6:30 PM arrival.

## Fourteen Southern Provinces, Clay-Pot Charcoal & Private Room Options
* **Zero Gas Stoves, Daily Express Seafood:** Every ingredient at Sorn is flown or driven daily from smallholders across Southern Thailand’s 14 provinces—from Surat Thani mud crabs and Tapi River prawns to Ranong mangosteens and Phuket lobster—cooked exclusively over coconut-husk charcoal and hand-pounded in granite mortars right before your course is plated.
* **Cooling Palate Cleansers & Riesling Pairings:** Because authentic Southern *Gaeng Tai Pla* and yellow turmeric crab curries pack exhilarating chili heat, Sorn’s sommelier team curates off-dry German Rieslings, grower Champagnes, and cold-pressed southern fruit elixirs that keep your palate refreshed.
* **Walkable Sukhumvit Nightcaps:** Stepping out of Sorn at 9:30 PM places your group five minutes from [Sing Sing Theater](/destinations/thailand/thailand-nightlife-sing-sing-theater-bangkok/) and [Tichuca Rooftop Bar](/destinations/thailand/thailand-nightlife-tichuca-rooftop-bangkok/).

## Ideal Championship Golf & Five-Star Hotel Pairings in Bangkok
Whether your group has spent the morning playing the historic tournament layout at [Thai Country Club](/courses/thailand/thai-country-club/), challenging the template holes of [Ballyshear Golf Links](/courses/thailand/ballyshear/), or navigating the fast greens of [Alpine Golf Club](/courses/thailand/alpine-golf-club/) and [Nikanti Golf Club](/courses/thailand/nikanti/), returning to [Sindhorn Kempinski Hotel Bangkok](/accommodations/thailand/sindhorn-kempinski/) for an afternoon spa recovery ensures you arrive at Sorn’s Sukhumvit Soi 26 garden villa rested for one of Asia’s most extraordinary culinary evenings.

faqs.q: How far in advance must golf groups request a reservation at Sorn in Bangkok?
faqs.a: Because Sorn is Thailand's most sought-after Michelin-starred dining room with very limited nightly tables, Asia Golf Specialists recommends confirming your Bangkok golf itinerary at least 60 to 90 days in advance so our concierge can coordinate your seating.

faqs.q: Can Sorn adjust the spice level of its Southern Thai tasting menu for sensitive palates?
faqs.a: Sorn's culinary identity is built around authentic Southern Thai curry pastes, so the menu remains bold and spicy, though the kitchen layers cooling herbal palate cleansers, cold-pressed juices, and coconut cream courses throughout the meal.

faqs.q: What is the dress code for golfers dining at Sorn in Sukhumvit?
faqs.a: Sorn enforces a smart-elegant dress code: gentlemen must wear collared shirts, tailored long trousers, and closed-toe leather shoes (shorts, sandals, and athletic wear are not permitted).
